note: Mostly wooded area on the Fox River north of Kahoka. Camping is on or beside the area's parking lots, four of them separately reached by gravel roads. This entry is the southeast lot on the north side of Route NN by the Fox River; the main camp with a privy is in the west unit off Route K. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed MDC 'Designated Camping Sites'; brochure: 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all graveled parking lots', 14 days in 30. Free/FCFS/no hookups. GIS has 5 camping points in 4 separate lot camps on separate roads: SE (= pin, off NN), NE (3.6 km, gravel road from V), W main (4.4 km, two lots + privy + 'Designated Camping Area', road from K) and NW (1.5 km from W). Two splits proposed (W main, NE). Pin ~60 m out in a grass field - move onto lot 1060. Not waterfront kept; phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION: the area page lists 'Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack(no Deer/Turkey); Designated Camping Sites'. The 02/2024 brochure says 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all graveled parking lots ... Stays are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period.' That is lot-side camping, and every GIS camping point sits beside a lot, so it isn't the 'camping only at the parking lot / not recommended' drop language. Reported for AWH since the camping is literally at the lots. Lot surfaces in GIS read 'Paved' except 3261 (gravel); imagery shows gravel.
CLUSTERS (GIS layer 27 + 03/17 map; four separate lot camps, each on its own road):

(1) SE = this entry: camping point 507 (40.56219,-91.85284) + lot 1060 (40.56205,-91.85356). A short gravel pull-in off the gravel road along the area's south edge (Route NN side), by the Fox River bottoms. The lot is small (~12 x 25 m) but takes a 23-ft rig.

(2) W main: camping points 509 (40.57959,-91.90101) and 619 'Designated Camping Area' (40.57689,-91.90138), lots 1061 (40.57915,-91.90006) and 3261 (gravel, 40.57729,-91.90066). It has the area's privy and accessible facilities, reached by a gravel road east from the county road off Route K. It's 4.4 km W of the pin.

(3) NE: camping point 508 (40.58997,-91.87435) + lot 1059 (40.59059,-91.87389), at the end of a gravel road south from Route V. Imagery shows a ~20 x 40 m gravel turnaround lot. It's 3.6 km NNW of the pin and 2.6 km from W main.
(4) NW: camping point 510 + lot 1058 (40.59102,-91.90586), off the gravel road along the north-west boundary. It's 1.5 km N of W main.

SPLIT PROPOSED (2 new entries): 'Charlie Heath Memorial CA - West' pinned on gravel lot 3261 at 40.5773,-91.9007 (the main camp: two lots, privy, designated camping area; own road from Route K), and 'Charlie Heath Memorial CA - Northeast' pinned on lot 1059 at 40.5906,-91.8739 (own road from Route V). The NW lot (4) is left as a cluster of the West entry. Its road is separate but it is 1.5 km from the main camp; split it too only if AWH wants all four.
PIN: stored 40.56219,-91.85284 (GIS camping point 507) sits ~60 m east of the lot in an open grass field. Suggest moving onto lot 1060 at 40.56205,-91.85356.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): the SE lot is ~250 m from the Fox River across fields and woods.
PHONE: (573) 248-2530 on the area page and brochure matches.
Season (manual, year-round) left as stored. Note: walk-in camping is closed during firearms deer/turkey seasons; lot camping isn't.
